title: Counting degrees of vertices in near Goldbach graphs
summary: A near Goldbach graph is a simple undirected graph whose vertex set consists of all positive even integers and there is an edge between two vertices $a,b$ if and only if $\frac{a+b}{2}, \frac{|a-b|}{2}$ are either odd primes or $1$. A finite near Goldbach graph $G(n)$ has the vertex set $\{x\in 2\mathbb{N}\, :\, x\leq 2n\}$ with the same adjacency rule. In this paper, we obtain two exact formulas for the degree of the even positive integer $x$ in $G(x/2)$.
